snippet.title: Frozen Reign | Version 14.3 | Winter Themed Maps | Italy Rework | New Weapon | #criticalstrike #xmas
snippet.description:
❄️ Frozen Reign Season Has Begun! 👑
The King marches onto the battlefield, the cold hits harder than ever, and your enemies won’t survive the frost.

📦 New Weapon: PP-19 Bizon 🦬

More bullets, more pain, the Bizon doesn’t negotiate; it overwhelms.

🪓 New Melee Weapon: Crowbar

And no, it’s not just for crates; some individuals even try to defuse C4 with it.

🎁 New Weapon Blueprints
🎄 Last Gift - Sharp as the Frost King’s glare, even Coin kit loses its power next to it.

💎 Emeroth (MPT-76) - Rumor has it Kharon isn’t fond of this one… maybe even jealous.

💀 Skullstorm (MPT-76) - It doesn’t fire bullets, it throws spears. Expect your enemies to suffer for it.

🔮 Snow Mercy (Crowbar) - If winter holds no mercy, neither should the one who wields it.

👑New Character Blueprint: Frost King (V-Hunter) 🧊
Each step freezes the battlefield beneath him. You’ve entered his domain now.

🛡 New Equipment & Consumables
⛑ Helmet: Nutcracker

The only thing cracking will be your enemies’ confidence.

🧥 Armor: Royal Coat

A royal mantle forged to shrug off both bullets and blizzards.

🥾 Boot: Arctic March

Every step grinds down more than ice, it crushes whatever courage your foes had left.

🆕New Consumable: Frostlight - Crystal Nova - Frozen Skull

🎰 New Seasonal Draw
Yuletide returns, colder, sharper, and ready to take the battlefield back.

⚙️ Improvements
Gameplay optimized for smoother performance under extreme conditions.

🔧 Bug Fixes
Minor issues melted away, the battlefield runs colder, but cleaner.
